title: Character Profiler 1.0.0
notes:
First stable release of Character Profiler.

Character Profiler 1.0.0 delivers the complete author-focused character development workflow developed through versions 0.4-0.8: graphical family relationships, deep Character Guide prompts, project backup and restore, hardened Visual Studio workflows, editable history and relationships, large-cast usability improvements, data-safety protections, hostile-backup validation, and release-quality persistence and error handling.

This release uses archive format v1 and introduces no incompatible SwiftData schema change.

Automated release validation passed the complete Xcode simulator test suite and an optimized Release-configuration build on the exact main commit tagged by this release.

Physical-device Image Playground output-quality validation remains a documented limitation.
